subject: package:ggdendro to plot dendrograms and tree plots using ggplot

messages.author: 99a1cfc66539313c
messages.subject: package:ggdendro to plot dendrograms and tree plots using ggplot
parts:
Dear ggplot community

I am very pleased to announce that I have published my package
ggdendro on CRAN and github.

The package description: "This is a set of tools for dendrograms and
tree plots using ggplot. The ggplot philosophy is to clearly separate
data from the presentation. Unfortunately the plot method for
dendrograms plots directly to a plot device without exposing the data.
The ggdendro package resolves this by making available functions that
extract the dendrogram plot data."

CRAN: http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ggdendro/index.html
github: https://github.com/andrie/ggdendro

An example:

library(ggplot2)
library(ggdendro)
hc <- hclust(dist(USArrests), "ave")
hcdata <- dendro_data(hc, type="rectangle")
ggplot() +
geom_segment(data=segment(hcdata), aes(x=x0, y=y0, xend=x1,
yend=y1)) +
geom_text(data=label(hcdata), aes(x=x, y=y, label=text, hjust=0),
size=3) +
coord_flip() + scale_y_reverse(expand=c(0.2, 0))



Regards

Andrie
